description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Template class, which is a core component of the Smarty templating engine. It manages template rendering, caching, compilation, inheritance, plugin handling, and other template-related functionalities within the Smarty system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Template
classes.description: Main class providing template data structures and methods for rendering, caching, compiling, inheritance, and plugin management within the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Smarty_Internal_Template object with specified resource, Smarty instance, parent template, cache and compile IDs, caching options, and configuration flags.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template, either displaying it directly or returning the output as a string, handling caching, compilation, and debugging.

methods.name: _subTemplateRender
methods.description: Handles the runtime process of rendering a sub-template, including cache management, variable assignment, and debugging.

methods.name: _subTemplateRegister
methods.description: Registers sub-templates and their call counts based on the compiled includes.

methods.name: _isSubTpl
methods.description: Checks if the current template is a sub-template.

methods.name: _assignInScope
methods.description: Assigns a variable to the template scope, optionally in a specific scope or with nocache flag.

methods.name: _checkPlugins
methods.description: Verifies that required plugins are loaded and callable, including dynamic include of plugin files if necessary.

methods.name: _decodeProperties
methods.description: Decodes properties from compiled or cached template files, validating timestamps and cache validity.

methods.name: compileTemplateSource
methods.description: Compiles the template source code into executable PHP code and saves it if necessary.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Writes rendered content to the cache resource.

methods.name: _getTemplateId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the template, used for caching and object management.

methods.name: capture_error
methods.description: Throws an exception if there is a mismatch in Smarty {capture} tags.

methods.name: loadCompiled
methods.description: Loads the compiled template object, creating it if not already loaded or forced.

methods.name: loadCached
methods.description: Loads the cached template object, creating it if not already loaded or forced.

methods.name: _loadInheritance
methods.description: Initializes the inheritance handling object if not already set.

methods.name: _cleanUp
methods.description: Resets internal callback arrays and inheritance object, typically called after rendering.

methods.name: loadCompiler
methods.description: Loads and initializes the template compiler class based on source properties.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles calls to undefined methods, forwarding them to Smarty or parent class as appropriate.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves Smarty properties or internal objects from the template context.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets Smarty properties or internal objects in the template context.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that releases cache locks if applicable.
